method: Existing continuityScorecard against production D1 using SELECT/PRAGMA only. No raw member records persisted or returned. Sequential reads are not a transactional snapshot.

day1Loop.reason: Meal selection is not evidence of eating. The four completed stages cannot currently be established.

firstWeekUsefulStep.window: Days 1–7 after first Today exposure; full Day 7 must have ended.
firstWeekUsefulStep.definition: Eligible Today starters who reported at least one saved help episode helpful within their first seven London calendar days. Each member counts once; missing feedback remains in the denominator. Latest answer per episode within the window is used. This is self-reported usefulness, not treatment effectiveness.

week1.window: Days 2–7; full Day 7 must have ended.

week4.window: Days 22–28; full Day 28 must have ended.

medicationElsewhere.reason: No explicit cohort segment capture is available. Prescription/provider details are not inferred.

recruitment.reason: Invitation and enrolment register not supplied.

openMemberP0s.reason: A reviewed issue register is required.

decision.reason: Success thresholds have not been set; this report cannot open the expansion gate.

scorecard.privacy: Aggregate only; no identities, health measurements, free text or episode contents returned.

definitions.exposure: First acknowledged visible Today panel, including members who never complete a check-in. Prospective capture; no registration/login backfill.
definitions.meaningfulAction: Retained check-ins, completed Fit/Next Shift actions and feedback on saved help, including the new everyday coach. Login, refresh, planning and meal selection do not count.
definitions.episodes: Persisted help offered by check-in/Next Shift or accepted everyday coaching, de-duplicated by linked episode ID; latest response per episode; skipping the question is unanswered. Window is episode delivery date.
definitions.helped: Member-reported product signal, not clinical efficacy.

limitations: Historical first Today exposure is unavailable before this instrumentation.
Browser acknowledgement is evidence of rendering, not independent proof of attention.
Retained Fit entries are capped by the existing product; erasure or overwritten records can reduce historical evidence.
Historical coach actions without an acceptance timestamp use preparation time as the episode-date proxy; preparation alone does not count as return.
Unlabelled staff/test identities cannot be excluded reliably.

memberConfirmedResolution.basis: Member explicitly confirmed the latest team reply answered the request. This does not measure clinical benefit.

supportFollowThrough.scope: All retained real-member coaching requests as of the report time, including requests older than the cohort window. Closed status is not proof that help was delivered. The 48-hour marker highlights waiting work; it is not a promised response time.
